name: Maze Warden TD
summary:
Maze Warden TD is a tower defense game in which the player builds the enemies' path. There is no fixed lane: walls can be placed anywhere that leaves a route open, and a preview shows how the enemies will reroute before each wall is placed. Sixteen towers, including piercing ballistas, chain lightning and a ricocheting sling, combine with terrain such as highland, leystone and lakes crossed by causeways.

The campaign spans 300 levels across fifteen regions. Its later worlds add rule changes: tides that flood causeways mid-wave, rune gates that teleport enemies, a dark vale lit only by towers and lanterns, enemies that avoid the strongest lane, and rifts that open during a wave. The game also has an endless survival mode, a weekly event and a Daily Siege played on a shared daily map.
